scg.text: Averru, the last numen, traps the red Primeval Rhammidarigaaz beneath a caldera in Shiv during the Fall of the Primevals, gaining the dragon's powers, and takes part in killing the white and green Numena, leaving only himself, Lowallyn and Kuberr.

After the birth of Karona ends the Numena's rule, he creates a spell to resurrect himself as a giant city, but Kamahl's arrival during the battle between Akroma and Phage disrupts his plans by triggering Karona's rebirth.
Karona blasts Averru with pure magic, destroying him and the city, and the last numen dies.
